current_answer: For a cautious first trial, use a portable marketing skill for a bounded output—copy draft, content plan, competitor list, page audit, or campaign analysis—then inspect the original source and require human review before any consequential action.

catalogue_card.question: Which AI-agent skills are useful for marketing, and how can marketers use them?
catalogue_card.text: Start with a source-inspected skill matched to a concrete job. The initial five focus on draft, planning, research, audit, and analysis; none was independently tested or presented as an autonomous publishing, sending, deployment, or spend tool.

summary: Five source-inspected portable skills cover content drafting, content planning, competitor research, public-URL search audit, and ad-export analysis.
The catalogue now has job-based browsing, a research library, an evaluation guide, and a methods page so the source record is visible alongside the entries.
All entries are original-source linked and carry a human review boundary; compatibility is a maintainer statement, not an install test.
uncertainty: No selected skill was installed, security-reviewed, legal/privacy-reviewed, benchmarked, or tested for marketing outcomes.
Repository branch links can change; no immutable commit or latest-update date was captured.
Host compatibility, model/runtime costs, and behavior vary and require a current host-specific check.
